day_local: NgoMgqibelo weVeki yamashumi amabini anesihlanu ngexesha eliqhelekileyo
greeting: Egameni likaYise, nelikaNyana, nelikaMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nemfesane kuthi. Kristu, ube nemfesane kuthi. Nkosi, ube nemfesane kuthi.
psalm_response: Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu.
homily:
Kukho umfanekiso othi cwaka, onokuthi uwubone ngeso lengqondo namhlanje. Cinga ngomntwana omncinci omi ecaleni kwesango, ebukele iindiza ezinkulu zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayengumfana owayethanda ukujonga phezulu. Wayengumfana owayenomdla ongenamida, umfana owayethanda ukwazi ukuba izinto zisebenza njani—ukusuka kwikhowudi yekhompyutha yakhe ukuya kwindlela ezindiza ngayo izindiza ezinkulu. Kodwa namhlanje, njengoko sijonga amazwi kaQoheleth, sikhunjuzwa ngento enzulu kakhulu: 'Khumbula uMdali wakho kwiintsuku zobutsha bakho.'

Qoheleth uthi, 'Konke kuli-zeze.' Ekuqaleni, la magama anokuziva enzima, mhlawumbi ngathi ayayicima imizamo yethu, amaphupha ethu, okanye ubomi obufutshane obufana nobukaBen. Kodwa makhe sime apha. Masithethe inyaniso. Sekuphele iinyanga ezintathu uBen esishiye. Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba indlu isenokuziva ithule ngendlela ebuhlungu kakhulu. Xa ucinga ngaloo mntwana owayesoloko enoncumo olukhanyisayo, owayethanda ukuhamba nehlabathi, kwaye owayesoloko ecinga ngabanye—njengaxa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukuze ancede umalumele umalume wakhe uWilliam—akukho xesha lonyaka linokuzisa ukuthula ngokukhawuleza. Usizi alulandeli ikhalenda.

Ndicela uthathe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola egxalabeni lakho. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. UThixo akathumeli ukugula. Ezinye izinto zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo.

KwiVangeli, uYesu uthi kubafundi bakhe: 'Nikelani ingqalelo koko ndinixelela khona. UNyana woMntu uza kunikelwa ezandleni zabantu.' Abafundi babesoyika ukubuza, babengaqondi. Babesoyika intlungu, babesoyika ukulahlekelwa. Kodwa uYesu wayebalungiselela ukuba baqonde ukuba ukuhamba kwakhe kwakungelilo ukuphela, kodwa yayilindlela eya eluxolweni. UBen wayengumfana owayephila ngothando, kwaye ngoku, ubomi bakhe busikhumbuza ukuba ubomi bethu abupheleli apha emhlabeni. UBen utyalwe emhlabeni ngendlela yomzimba, kodwa uya kuvuka ngendlela yomoya—ngomzimba oqaqambileyo, onamandla, nowonwabileyo phambi koThixo.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyamthanda. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekukhathalele. Qhubeka uphila ngesibindi, ube ngumfana owayeyiyo—onemfesane, onobubele, nonesibindi. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya ngomsebenzi wakhe wothando, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi eCà Mau, olethela ubomi kwabanye. Uthando lwakhe aluzange luphele; lusaqhubeka lukhanya njengolwandle olukhulu.

Nani, Alan noThao, ningayeki ukuthanda. Nithandeke kakhulu nguThixo. UBen wayengumfana onikela ngayo yonke into yakhe. Nani, nikani konke usizi lwenu kuThixo. Musani ukuzama ukuluthwala lodwa. Vumelani uYesu ukuba abe lulwalwa lwenu. Xa uziva usizi, yithi: 'Nkosi, ndiyakuthanda, kwaye ndiyakuthemba.' UBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo. Uthando lwenu luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye uBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Uthando lwakho lulukhanya olungasoze lwavaleleka. Uthando lwakho, njengaloo mthombo wamanzi, luyaqhubeka luhleli, lusaqhubeka lukhula, kwaye luyaqhubeka lukhanyisa iindlela zethu. Khumbula ukuba uBen uyaqhubeka esidumisela kuThixo, kwaye nathi, simele siphile ngaloo ndlela—ngothando olungagciniyo, ngoxolelo olungapheliyo, nangokholo olomeleleyo. Benjamin, lala ngokuthula. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam, Yesu Kristu, ndiyakholwa ukuba ukhona ngenene kwiSakramente eNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku kwiSakramente, nceda uze kum ngokomoya. Ndiyamkela, njengokungathi sele ufikile, ndize ndizibophelele kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uthando lukaThixo, uxolo lweNkosi, kunye nobudlelwane boMoya oyiNgcwele bungahlala nani namhlanje naphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen nabo bonke abasishiyeyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abalilayo naba lusizi, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elomeleleyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Thaba, mfana, kwiintsuku zobutsha bakho, intliziyo yakho mayikuvuyise kwiintsuku zobutsha bakho. Hamba ngeendlela zentliziyo yakho, nangokubona kwamehlo akho; kodwa yazi ukuba ngako konke oku, uThixo uya kukugweba. Susa usizi entliziyweni yakho, ususe ububi phambi kwakho, nangona ukusa kobutsha kudlula ngokukhawuleza. Khumbula uMdali wakho kwiintsuku zobutsha bakho, phambi kokuba iintsuku ezimbi zize, neminyaka isondele apho uya kuthi, andinavuyo kuyo; phambi kokuba ilanga libe mnyama, nenyanga, neenkwenkwezi, ngeli lixa amafu ebuyayo emva kwemvula; xa abagcini bendlu bangcangcazelayo, namadoda anamandla egobileyo, nabo bagayayo bengenanto ngenxa yokuba bembalwa, nabo bajonga ngeefestile beba ziimfama; xa iingcango zesitalato zivaliwe, nesandi sesingayo siphantsi; xa umntu elinde ukukhala kwentaka, kodwa iintombi zengoma zicinyiwe; xa umntu esoyika ukuphakama, neengozi esitalatweni; xa umthi we-almond udubula, nenkumbi isiba nobuvila, nesiqhamo se-caper singabi nampembelelo, kuba umntu esiya ekhaya lakhe laphakade, nabalili behamba ezitalatweni; phambi kokuba intambo yesilivere iqhawuke, nesitya segolide sophuke, nembiza yaphuke emthonjeni, ne-pulley eyaphukileyo iwele emthonjeni, nothuli lubuyele emhlabeni njengoko lwalunjalo, nomphefumlo ubuyele kuThixo owawunika. Izeze lezeze, utsho uQoheleth, konke kuli-zeze!

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu. Ujika umntu abuyele eluthulini, usithi, 'Buyani, zizukulwana zabantu.' Kuba iminyaka eliwaka emehlweni akho injengezolo, ngeli lixa lidlulileyo, okanye njengomlindo wobusuku. R. Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu. Ubanika isiphelo ebuthongweni babo; ngentsasa elandelayo banjengengca etshintshayo, Ehluma ngokutsha ekuseni, kodwa ngokuhlwa iyabuna iyaphela. R. Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu. Sifundise ukubala iintsuku zethu ngokufanelekileyo, ukuze sifumane ubulumko bentliziyo. Buyela, Nkosi! Kude kube nini? Yiba nemfesane kubakhonzi bakho! R. Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu. Sisithise ngokusa ngobubele bakho, ukuze sidanduluke ngovuyo nangolwando kwiintsuku zethu zonke. Kwaye ngamana ukhathalelo lweNkosi uThixo wethu lungaba lolwethu; ube nempumelelo emsebenzini wezandla zethu kuthi! Yenza umsebenzi wezandla zethu ube nempumelelo! R. Esi thetshini nasizukulwaneni, Nkosi, ubusisikhuselo sethu.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngeli lixa bonke bemangalisiwe yizenzo zakhe zonke, uYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe, 'Nikelani ingqalelo koko ndinixelela khona. UNyana woMntu uza kunikelwa ezandleni zabantu.' Kodwa abazange bakuqonde oku kuthetha; intsingiselo yoko yayifihlakele kubo ukuze bangakuqondi, kwaye babesoyika ukubuza ngale ntetho.

day: Saturday of the Twenty-Fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
